name: MinerSentinel
description:
MinerSentinel is a self-hosted monitoring solution designed for Bitcoin home miners running Bitaxe and Avalon Nano 3s ASIC devices. It provides a centralized dashboard to track performance, health, and profitability metrics across your entire mining fleet.

**Real-Time Device Monitoring**
Monitor hashrate, temperature, power consumption, and efficiency for each device. Visual status indicators show online/offline state and hardware health at a glance.

**Multi-Device Fleet Management**
Add unlimited Bitaxe and Avalon miners through a simple web interface. Dynamic device management allows adding or removing devices without service restarts. Each device displays individual statistics with drill-down detail views.

**Pool Integration**
Native support for CKPool and Public Pool solo mining statistics. Track your best shares, worker counts, and pool-side hashrate. View historical difficulty submissions and probability calculations for solo block discovery.

**Advanced Analytics**
Visualize performance trends with interactive charts. Compare efficiency across devices, analyze power consumption patterns, and predict maintenance needs. Time-series data stored in PostgreSQL enables historical trend analysis.

**Intelligent Alerts**
Telegram integration delivers instant notifications for critical events. Receive alerts for device offline status, hashrate stagnation, and new best difficulty achievements. Automatic device restart attempts when stagnation is detected.

**Built for Self-Sovereignty**
Runs entirely on your own hardware with no external dependencies. All data stays local. Designed for the server with Docker containerization for easy deployment and updates.
short_desc: Unified monitoring dashboard for Bitaxe and Avalon Bitcoin miners
author: Davide Bert
